english_title: Recognising and Responding to A Basic Meal Choice
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — a basic meal choice
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a basic meal choice; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Anna asks Ms Lan what to have for lunch.
context_note_vi: Chị Anna hỏi chị Lan ăn gì cho bữa trưa.

turns.speaker: Ms Anna
turns.english: Lan, what shall we have for lunch?
turns.vietnamese: Lan này, mình ăn gì cho bữa trưa đây?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Hôm nay mình ăn mì đi.
